primary.found_by: Found by an EXTERNAL VALIDATOR -- rct-extractor-v2's outcome-grouping guard, written independently by people who hit these defect classes separately. Verified here against every registration before acting. primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

pooled.withdrawn_reason: WITHDRAWN 2026-08-18, HOURS AFTER IT WAS BUILT. Correcting an arm inversion in the IRONMAN row changed this pool from RR 0.7987 (0.7490-0.8517) with I2=0% to RR 0.976 (0.624-1.527) with I2=97.9%, AND THE TWO TRIALS NOW POINT IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS: AFFIRM-AHF 0.776, IRONMAN 1.225. IRONMAN FAVOURING THE CONTROL ARM CONTRADICTS THE PUBLISHED TRIAL. Combined with the fact that NCT02642562 POSTS NO RESULTS SECTION AT ALL -- so these counts did not come from the registry and this object never recorded where they did -- the IRONMAN row cannot be relied on in either direction. A POOL AT I2=97.9% BUILT ON AN UNATTRIBUTED ROW WHOSE DIRECTION CONTRADICTS ITS OWN TRIAL IS NOT AN ESTIMATE. Withdrawn until the IRONMAN counts are sourced.

pooled_hartung_knapp.why_it_is_shown: Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.4.5 recommends Hartung-Knapp where k is small. Shown ALONGSIDE the unadjusted interval, not instead of it. A FLOOR OF 1 is applied to the variance-inflation factor so the adjustment can never NARROW the interval below the unadjusted one.

heterogeneity.DIRECTION_TEST: SUBSTANTIVE -- I-squared is 97.9% AND the trial intervals do not all exclude 1, or do not all point the same way. The trials disagree on WHETHER. THE POOLED POINT IS A NUMBER AND NOT A CONCLUSION.
heterogeneity.how_to_read_this_at_low_k: At k=2 or k=3 these statistics are weak evidence about consistency in EITHER direction. A low value means the estimates are CONSISTENT WITH a common effect, not that one is demonstrated.

harmonised_cvdeath_or_hfh.WHY_THIS_REPLACES_A_WITHDRAWAL: HARMONISED DATA WAS CHECKED FOR BEFORE WITHDRAWING, which is the SGLT2 lesson. AFFIRM-AHF and IRONMAN both register a CV-death-or-HF-hospitalisation composite and both post arm-level counts. CONFIRM-HF and FAIR-HF registered FUNCTIONAL primaries -- six-minute walk distance and patient global assessment -- and have no comparable event endpoint, so they are excluded rather than converted.

estimand: first occurrence of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure, both trials

harmonised_cvdeath_or_hfh.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that either trial is free of bias -- no risk-of-bias assessment is recorded. NOT a result for CONFIRM-HF's or FAIR-HF's populations, which are absent here. NOT that intravenous iron does not improve functional capacity: that is what those two trials measured and it is a different question.
harmonised_cvdeath_or_hfh.ARM_INVERSION_CORRECTED_2026_08_18: THE IRONMAN ROW WAS INVERTED WHEN THIS POOL WAS FIRST BUILT, HOURS AGO. I read the object arms in order and assigned arms[0] to the intervention. arms[0] IS THE CONTROL: the object labels it "Standard care" (336/569) and arms[1] "Standard care plus IV iron infusion" (411/568). The REGISTRY confirms the direction -- NCT02642562 types "Standard care" as NO_INTERVENTION and "Standard care plus IV iron infusion" as EXPERIMENTAL. POSITION IN A LIST IS NOT A ROLE, and the label and the registry arm type both said so. Corrected: IV iron 411/568 against control 336/569.
harmonised_cvdeath_or_hfh.found_by: Found by an INDEPENDENT BLINDED REVIEW on OpenAI GPT-5 via Codex, given four rebuilt objects cold with no knowledge of how or why they were built. Its single most serious finding: "FCM-HF IRONMAN row. The live headline pool depends on it, while its own fields contradict registry availability and treatment/control assignment. That can flip the effect." IT DID FLIP THE EFFECT. FIFTH outside check this week to find what our own passes missed -- and the first to catch a defect I introduced the same day.
harmonised_cvdeath_or_hfh.what_is_owed: The IRONMAN CV-death-or-HF-hospitalisation counts from a stated source. The registry posts none. Until then AFFIRM-AHF stands alone at RR 0.776 (293/558 vs 372/550), registry-verified, and one trial is a trial rather than a synthesis.
harmonised_cvdeath_or_hfh.the_sequence_worth_recording: Built, corrected, withdrawn -- within hours. The first build inverted the arms; an independent blinded review caught it; the correction flipped the result and revealed that the underlying row was unattributed and pointed the wrong way. THE INVERSION WAS MINE AND THE UNATTRIBUTED ROW PREDATES ME. Neither was visible without the other.

It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. This review asks: In Multiple trial-declared outcomes: HF Hospitalizations and CV Death | Number of Deaths, what do the contributing trials show?

It examines 4 randomised trials and DOES NOT POOL THEM, against not recorded on the page this object was extracted from.

The outcomes sought are Multiple trial-declared outcomes: HF Hospitalizations and CV Death | Number of Deaths; cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure.
